175536.overview:
Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 4 for the Zodiac is roughly based on the Game Boy Advance version, but the game's graphics have a much higher resolution to them due to the Zodiac's greater processing power.

The game also has Bluetooth support, so if you have up to three friends with a Zodiac, you can enjoy some multiplayer games, like trick attack, horse, and so on, and scores from the single, timed sessions sessions can be posted to an online scoreboard (on Tapwave's website) via the Zodiac's hot-sync abilities.

457774.overview:
It's 1984, and world peace hangs by a thread. CIA agents are captured before they can relay vital information... the Soviets are going to invade the United States!

TIGER TEAM is the 3D attack helicopter game that puts you in the thick of the action. Grab the controls of the U.S. Apache AH-64 helicopter or side with the Red Army and take command of the Soviets' deadly 'Hind' gunship in this battle for world domination.

Each mission is jam-packed with action, featuring rescue, ground attack or air-to-air combat objectives. And the fighting never ends because TIGER TEAM's random mission generator creates thousands of unique missions that only you can complete!
